description.text: A fine-tuned version of **Gemma 3N** designed for emergency response scenarios. Powers the **Citizen2Responder** app with dual-mode capabilities: natural guidance for bystanders and structured tool outputs for EMTs — all with a privacy-first, local deployment focus.

output_type.quote: Natural Conversation Mode. Step-by-step emergency guidance. No medical jargon. Real-time questioning & coaching.

use_claim.quote: natural guidance for bystanders and structured tool outputs for EMTs

warning.quote: Should not replace EMTs in critical care situations

purpose_stated.quote: A fine-tuned version of **Gemma 3N** designed for emergency response scenarios. Powers the **Citizen2Responder** app with dual-mode capabilities: natural guidance for bystanders and structured tool outputs for EMTs — all with a privacy-first, local deployment focus.

quotes: Generates structured EMT/dispatch reports. JSON-style outputs for system use.

serving.text_only_input_quote: prompt = "Someone collapsed and is not responding. What should I assess first?"
serving.notes: The card example also sets temperature 0.7 and max_length 200. config.json is Gemma3nForConditionalGeneration with vision_config and audio_config; the Hub safetensors metadata reports 7,849,978,192 F32 parameters while the card says 4B. The training script sets finetune_vision_layers=False and load_in_4bit=True, then save_pretrained_merged. per_device_train_batch_size is 1 with gradient_accumulation_steps 8 (the script comment says effective batch size 8). tokenizer_config.json has use_default_system_prompt false and no chat_template key; the template is chat_template.jinja and it can insert an image token if the caller sends one. The app README says text goes to this model and vision goes to a cloud model because llama.rn does not support vision or audio. medical_emergency_dataset.json metadata says total_scenarios 50; the scenarios array has 20 objects. forced_tool_calls_dataset.json metadata and array both have 12. Neither file is a Hub dataset. No arXiv paper names this repository.

evaluation_reported.text: Recognizes emergency types (>95%). Accurate tool calls (>90%). EMT-approved safety outputs. Mobile ready (GGUF quantized). The card does not describe the test set.

discrepancies: Inventory methods is lora. The training script that sets HF_REPO_ID to this repository loads unsloth/gemma-3n-E4B-it with load_in_4bit=True and LoRA r=16, alpha=16, which is QLoRA, then saves a merged model. The dataset filenames and the parent match the inventory. The card does not name the dataset files. The card says 4B parameters; the safetensors metadata total is 7,849,978,192 F32. Epochs are not stated; training is max_steps 200.
